name: claude-ha-addon
description: Home Assistant add-on that runs Claude Code with a mobile-first ACP session UI

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w mock-acp
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
